```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(gridExtra)
library(stringr)

```

```{r}
Travel_Data = read.csv("/Users/Dajia/Desktop/Projects/R/1-Tavel Data/Travel Dataset.csv")
Travel_Data
```


```{r}
Travel_Data$Country <- sub(".*,\\s*", "", Travel_Data$Destination)


country_counts <- Travel_Data %>%
  group_by(Country) %>%
  summarise(Count = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))
country_counts

ggplot(country_counts, aes(x = reorder(Country, -Count), y = Count)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "darkgreen") +
  labs(title = "Countries",
       x = "Country",
       y = "Number of Visits") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
  plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,vjust=1) 

```




```{r}
ggplot(Travel_Data, aes(x = Destination, y = Traveler.Age)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0) +
  labs(title = "Age vs Destination", x = "Destination", y = "Age") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))


```

```{r}


accommodation_summary <- Travel_Data %>%
  group_by(Accommodation.Type) %>%
  summarise(Average_Cost = mean(`Accommodation.Cost..`, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(accommodation_summary, aes(x = reorder(Accommodation.Type, Average_Cost), y = Average_Cost, fill = Accommodation.Type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Average Accommodation Cost by Type",
       x = "Accommodation Type",
       y = "Average Cost ($)",
       fill = "Accommodation Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +  
  coord_flip()  




```

```{r}

Travel_Data <- Travel_Data %>%
  mutate(Traveler.Nationality = str_trim(str_to_title(Traveler.Nationality)))


nationality_corrections <- c(
  "Usa" = "American",
  "United States" = "American",
  "America" = "Merican",
  "United Kingdom" = "British",
  "Uk" = "United Kingdom",
  "South Korean" = "South Korean",
  "South South Korean" = "South Korean",
  "Taiwan" = "Taiwanesese",
  "Uae" = "United Arab Emirates",
  "United Arab Emirates" = "Emirati",
  "Brazil" = "Brazilian",
  "China" = "Chinese",
  "Germany" = "German",
  "Italy" = "Italian",
  "Japan" = "Japanese",
  "South Korea" = "South Korean",
  "South Koreann" = "South Korean",
  "South South Koreann" = "South Korean",
  "Spain" = "Spanish",
  "Taiwaneseese" = "Taiwansese",
  "Taiwanese" = "Taiwansese",
  "Hong Kong" = "Hong Kongese"
 
 
  
)

Travel_Data <- Travel_Data %>%
  mutate(Traveler.Nationality = recode(Traveler.Nationality, !!!nationality_corrections))


nationality_counts <- Travel_Data %>%
  group_by(Traveler.Nationality) %>%
  summarise(Count = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))


nationality_counts$Legend_Label <- paste(nationality_counts$Traveler.Nationality, "-", nationality_counts$Count)


pie_chart <- ggplot(nationality_counts, aes(x = "", y = Count, fill = Legend_Label)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +  
  labs(title = "Nationality Distribution of Travelers") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.title = element_blank()) +  
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Traveler Nationality")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rainbow(nrow(nationality_counts)))  


print(pie_chart)
```
